drhp.business: Eleganz provides integrated interior contracting and design-and-build / fit-out solutions, combining in-house design capabilities, project management expertise, skilled professionals and technology across the full project lifecycle (design, planning, procurement, execution, project management, delivery). It serves corporate and multinational clients for workplace and commercial interior environments.
drhp.end_markets: Information Technology (IT)|Data centre|hospitality|industrial|healthcare|retail|commercial office spaces|Global Capability Centres (GCCs)
drhp.expansion: Eleganz has grown from a Mumbai general-contracting firm into a design-and-build / interior fit-out company with operations across Mumbai (HQ), Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune in India, and an international presence in Singapore. The company states it will continue expanding its execution capabilities and investing in design innovation, operational excellence and digital project management, and is evaluating adjacencies across the workplace lifecycle, to be disclosed once any such opportunity reaches board consideration. No named capex project with a commissioning/completion timeline is disclosed in this bundle.
drhp.mdna: India's Grade-A office absorption touched record highs, driven in large measure by Global Capability Centres choosing India as their home, which the company says it sits directly in the path of.|Demand for high-quality, sustainable, and technology-enabled interior fit-out solutions continues to grow as businesses expand, modernize, and optimize their workplaces.|Sustainability is increasingly a qualification (not just a preference) to serve global corporate clients, seen as a source of client preference.

sk.overview: Innovision operates across India's manpower services (manned private security and integrated facility management), toll-plaza management and skill-development/vocational training, with a nascent drone-operations training vertical. These are large, structurally growing, and highly fragmented labour-intensive service markets driven by formalisation, outsourcing, urbanisation and government infrastructure/skilling programmes (per the issuer-commissioned CARE Report dated January 28, 2026).

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening presence in high-growth sectors — IT & ITeS, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), hospitality, healthcare, industrial and manufacturing facilities, commercial offices, data centre and warehousing.
- Continued investment in design innovation, operational excellence, digital project management, and sustainable practices while expanding execution capabilities.
- Embedding sustainable practices across the project lifecycle — responsible material selection and waste reduction on site.
- Evaluating adjacencies across the workplace lifecycle beyond the core design-and-build business, to be disclosed to shareholders once any opportunity reaches board consideration.
